title: Huge Inductive Invariant Proofs and State Space Limits in A Simplified Layout Algebra for GPU Kernels (C)
topic: A Simplified Layout Algebra for GPU Kernels
description: Formal layout algebra and dimension mapping invariants for GPU tensor kernels.
abstract: Modern deep learning workloads require complex multidimensional tensor manipulations on GPU architectures. This paper formalizes a simplified layout algebra for GPU kernels, proving height-balance and bijective dimension mapping invariants.
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints
